skill.name: community-marketing
skill.description: Design, launch, grow, and measure online communities that create member value and support product growth.
skill.summary: Create actionable community strategies, engagement programs, member journeys, and health audits.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting or ordinary prose. The skill contains no executable commands, network reconnaissance, prompt injection, or other semantic security concern.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 15 uses Markdown inline backticks to name optional product-marketing context files. It instructs the agent to read an existing file and contains no shell or Ruby execution.
Lines 56-60 are a fenced Markdown diagram of a community flywheel. The backticks delimit prose and do not invoke a shell or execute commands.
Lines 46-47 list member benefits such as exclusive knowledge and peer connections. They contain no network discovery, scanning, requests, targets, or reconnaissance instructions.

content.value_statement: Community programs often lack a clear member promise, operating plan, and measurable goals. This skill turns your context into practical strategies, journeys, rituals, and audits.
actual_capabilities: Defines a community identity, member value proposition, primary goal, and repeatable participation loop.
Creates 90-day launch plans for Discord, Slack, Circle, Reddit, Facebook Groups, or forums.
Designs channel structures, welcome sequences, first-week prompts, and recurring community rituals.
Produces ambassador program briefs with candidate criteria, benefits, outreach, tools, and measurement plans.
Audits community health using activation, reply, churn, contribution, and engagement signals.
limitations: Does not access community platforms, member records, analytics systems, or private conversations.
Does not publish posts, configure channels, recruit members, or moderate discussions.
Recommendations depend on accurate product, audience, platform, stage, and capacity information.
Metric benchmarks are general guidance and may require adjustment for the community model.

use_cases.title: Launch a customer community
use_cases.description: Create a platform recommendation, founding-member plan, initial content, core participation loop, and 90-day operating schedule.

use_cases.title: Improve member activation
use_cases.description: Diagnose where new members disengage and redesign onboarding, welcome messages, prompts, recognition, and recurring rituals.

use_cases.title: Build an advocate program
use_cases.description: Define advocate criteria, benefits, personal outreach, enablement materials, and referral measurement around existing customer enthusiasm.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a community platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a community platform for [audience] around [product]. Our primary goal is [goal], and our weekly management capacity is [hours].
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare suitable platforms before launching a community.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a community launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day launch plan for a [platform] community serving [member profile]. Include founding-member recruitment, seeded discussions, rituals, and weekly metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn an early community idea into an operating plan.

prompt_templates.title: Audit community health
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our [platform] community using these metrics: [metrics]. Diagnose activation and engagement problems, then rank three actions by expected impact and effort.
prompt_templates.scenario: Find practical improvements for an existing community.

prompt_templates.title: Design a community growth system
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a community-led growth system for [product] and [audience]. Connect identity, member value, onboarding, rituals, advocacy, support, product feedback, and measurable business outcomes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Develop an advanced strategy that connects community operations with product growth.

output_examples.input: Create a launch plan for a private Slack community for 40 B2B analytics customers.
output_examples.output: A 90-day plan covering founding-member outreach, channel purposes, seeded discussions, weekly expert sessions, onboarding messages, owner assignments, and activation metrics.

output_examples.input: Our Discord has 2,000 members, but few new members post after introductions.
output_examples.output: A health audit identifying first-week activation gaps, followed by revised welcome prompts, guided channel actions, peer responses, recognition, and weekly measurement.

output_examples.input: Design an ambassador program for customers who already recommend our design product.
output_examples.output: A program brief with selection criteria, personal invitations, tiered benefits, shareable resources, a private feedback channel, referral tracking, and review milestones.

best_practices: Provide the product, ideal member, platform, community stage, primary goal, and available management time.
Share current engagement metrics and member feedback when requesting an audit or growth plan.
Review assumptions, assign owners, and test recommendations with a small member cohort before scaling.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize member counts without defining the recurring value members receive.
Do not launch many empty channels before establishing a focused participation loop.
Do not automate personal outreach or recognition that depends on trust and individual context.

faq.question: Which community platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It compares Discord, Slack, Circle, Reddit, Facebook Groups, and Discourse-style forums using audience, discovery, search, cost, and operating needs.

faq.question: Can it create a community strategy from limited information?
faq.answer: Yes. It can state reasonable assumptions, but product, audience, goal, stage, and capacity details produce more relevant recommendations.

faq.question: Can it manage or moderate my community?
faq.answer: No. It creates plans, templates, structures, and measurement guidance but does not access platforms or perform moderation.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing community?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide current member journeys, activity patterns, metrics, complaints, and operational constraints for a focused health audit.

faq.question: Does it support ambassador programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define candidate criteria, benefits, outreach, enablement materials, referral tracking, and an iteration schedule.

faq.question: What outputs can it produce?
faq.answer: It can produce strategy documents, channel architectures, member journeys, ritual calendars, ambassador briefs, and community health audits.
